package sample

import "example.com/dev"

const (
	A = "a"
	B, C = "b", "c:d"
	N = 3
	E = A + "x"
)

const Lone = `raw "text"`

var notConst = "v"

func other(v string) {
	switch v {
	case "elsewhere":
	}
}

func (r *recv) act(a string, n int) {
	verb, arg := dev.Split(a)
	if n > 0 {
		switch verb {
		case dev.Unblock, dev.GuestAuth:
		default:
			return
		}
	}
	switch verb {
	case dev.Reboot:
	case dev.Scan, "spectrum-scan":
		switch {
		case arg == "x":
		}
	case dev.LED + ":" + dev.On:
	default:
	}
	switch r.Cmd {
	case "kick-sta", "kick":
	}
}
